confirmedDateTime.description: Confirmed reservation date-time only when the requested slot was clearly confirmed.

reservationNameProvided.description: Whether the AI provided the system-supplied reservation name during the call.

phoneNumberProvided.description: Whether the AI provided the system-supplied contact number during the call.

restaurantRequestedNameOrPhone.description: Whether the restaurant requested the reservation name or contact number.

alternativeDateTime.description: Restaurant-suggested alternative date-time. Presence implies NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.

transcriptSummary.description: AI-generated call summary candidate, not a recording transcript.
